sources.note: Geva et al., 'Transformer Feed-Forward Layers Are Key-Value Memories' — the chapter's framing; the figures restate the chapter's parameter arithmetic, not the paper's.
Vaswani et al. 2017 — the four-times inner width the chapter traces.
Shazeer 2020 — the gated variant and the 8d_model/3 width that holds the 8d_model² budget.

figures.title: d_model → 4d_model → d_model, with the residual running past
figures.caption: The feed-forward sublayer reads one position's residual vector, widens it to four times d_model, bends each coordinate, and contracts back to d_model. The bypass is the residual addition that attention also leaves intact. At d_model = 4,096 and m = 16,384 the pair holds 8d_model² = 134,217,728 parameters per layer.
figures.alt: A horizontal lane starts at x, a vector of width d_model = 4,096. Five stages follow: W1 projects d_model up to m = 4d_model = 16,384; a bend applies an elementwise nonlinearity; W2 projects m back down to d_model; the result is added to x. A separate line above the stages carries the residual stream straight from x to the addition. Labels under the stages give the width at each stage and the 8d_model² = 134,217,728 parameter count.

data.note: Per layer the pair holds 2·d_model·m = 8d_model² = 134,217,728 parameters at d_model = 4,096, twice attention's 4d_model². A gated variant replaces the single up-projection with W_g and W_v and sets m = 8d_model/3, so 3·d_model·m stays 8d_model².

anim.intro: Press Play or Next to walk the feed-forward sublayer.

steps.label: Read one position's residual vector x, width d_model.
Bend each coordinate; no mixing across positions.
Add the result to x; the identity path is unbroken.

figures.title: Feed-forward is 57.3 percent of untied parameters
figures.caption: At d_model = 4,096, L = 32, and V = 128,000, the feed-forward pair holds 4,294,967,296 of the 7,491,026,944 parameters with untied embeddings, a 57.3 percent share. Attention holds 2,147,483,648 and the embeddings 1,048,576,000; tying the embeddings lifts the feed-forward share to 61.7 percent.
figures.alt: Three horizontal bars. Feed-forward is longest at 4,294,967,296; attention is half that at 2,147,483,648; untied embeddings are 1,048,576,000. The note gives the untied total 7,491,026,944 and the 57.3 percent share, and the tied total 6,966,738,944 with a 61.7 percent share.

data.note: d_model = 4,096, L = 32, V = 128,000. Untied total 7,491,026,944, feed-forward share 57.3%. Tied embeddings halve the embedding term to 524,288,000: total 6,966,738,944, share 61.7%. A gated FFN keeps the same 8L·d_model² by setting m = 8d_model/3, so 3·d_model·m = 8d_model².
